data.full_args:
{"command": "cd /testbed && python -c "
from collections import Counter
from faker import Faker
f = Faker(); Faker.seed(0)
for lo, hi in [(-50,50),(-100,0),(0,100),(-200,-100)]:
    c = Counter(f.pydecimal(min_value=lo, max_value=hi, right_digits=0) for _ in range(20000))
    n = len(c)
    print(f'[{lo},{hi}] unique={n} min={min(c.values())} max={max(c.values())} expect~{20000//n}')
""}
